text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Say, Trainer, didn't you say we'd go on
some
away races after the Wakagoma
Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I know the Kokura Kinen is our goal, but
have you
already decided what other
races I'll be taking
on?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature doubts her own strength.
She simply
lacks confidence. Which race
she enters won't
change that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her anxiety is apparent in the way she
keeps
averting her gaze. I suppose it's
something she
can't shake, even if she
knows better. In that
case...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Pfff, ahahaha! Yeah, you're totally right!
It is a
trip after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Pickles and fireflies sound good to me.
Might as
well choose races around
there...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Like maybe the Kyoto Shimbun Hai in
Kyoto and
the Naruo Kinen at Hanshin
Racecourse?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Let me know in advance if we're going
for sure,
okay? I want to have time to
look up sightseeing
spots and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not a bad idea for her to run in the
Kyoto
Shimbun Hai and Naruo Kinen
before the Kokura
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hope those races can help Nice Nature
gain
some confidence...
